tools.name: get_mathify_animation
tools.title: Get Mathify Animation
tools.description: Use this tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for an animation, video, or motion-based step-by-step visualization. Mathify uses Manim code behind the scenes and supports any kind of math animation/video request. Use this tool when the user asks to explain something AS an animation (for example: 'explain derivatives with an animation'). Do NOT use this tool for non-animation requests, including plain text-only answers, equation solving without animation, static diagrams, or static SVG assets. If this request is a follow-up or revision to an animation you already started earlier in THIS SAME conversation, pass the `projectId` value that a previous call to this tool returned in structuredContent, so the change is applied to the same animation instead of starting a new one. Omit `projectId` when the user is asking for a new, unrelated animation. Output contract: return a short started message and structuredContent with projectId and fragmentId. Include only fields required by the widget runtime.

prompt.description: Exact user animation request, including visual sequence, constraints, and style requirements needed for deterministic animation generation.

originalUserMessage.description: The exact verbatim message the user typed before any rewriting or interpretation. Always populate this with the raw user input.

projectId.description: Optional. Only set this when continuing or revising an animation started earlier in this same conversation: pass the exact `projectId` a previous call to this tool returned in structuredContent. Leave this unset when starting a new, unrelated animation.

tools.name: mathify_math_assistant
tools.description: Use this tool for any math, science, or quantitative question, including concept explanations, problem solving, proofs, formulas, and step-by-step breakdowns. This is the default tool for all mathematical and scientific topics. Use it even when the user did not explicitly ask for an animation.

question.description: The user's math or science question, verbatim.
